name: Recruitment Letter
summary: Takrin Pathseeker sends promising adventurers from Durotar west to serve in the Barrens. His letter directs able-bodied volunteers to the border outpost run by Kargal Battlescar.

sections.title: Enlistment for the Frontier
sections.body: Takrin Pathseeker watches young warriors and scouts prove themselves around Razor Hill. He chooses those who seem strong enough for frontline service and gives them a letter for duty in the Barrens. Across the Southfury River bridge, recruits leave Durotar’s sheltered red dirt and join the Horde’s guard against quilboar, centaur, and Alliance scouts.

sections.title: Reporting to Battlescar
sections.body: Kargal Battlescar receives the recruits at the outpost just across the river. The grizzled veteran manages the post and evaluates each conscript before signing off on their enlistment. A signed recruit is soon sent farther west to the Crossroads, where the frontier outposts are stretched thin.

faq.answer: Takrin Pathseeker hands out the letter. The orc scout is posted along the road from Razor Hill and watches for capable recruits heading west.

faq.q: Where does this letter need to go?
aliases: where do i take recruitment letter
who do i give it to
faq.answer: You take the letter to Kargal Battlescar at the orc watchpost just across the Southfury River bridge, on the border of Durotar and the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens once the letter is signed?
faq.answer: Kargal signs the document to formalize your enlistment, then orders you deeper into the plains to report for duty at the Crossroads, where reinforcements are urgently needed.

faq.q: Why is the Horde conscripting adventurers in the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Horde conscripts adventurers because the Barrens is a sprawling, dangerous land that connects major Horde settlements. Centaur clans, aggressive Bristleback quilboar, and Alliance operations keep the threat constant, and frontline commanders need every able hand.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, carrying this letter marks your move from local defense in Durotar to active military service across the Kalimdor frontier.
As a young orc, presenting a signed letter of service to a veteran like Kargal Battlescar is an early step toward earning honor under Warchief Thrall’s new Horde.
